payload.description: Components now exist on discourse/redmine/spree (136/519 after PR #69) but their ~37 gold data-flows score 0. The flow detector emits flows with correct identity keys (flow:asset:api->asset:database) but they don't match gold, which expects intra-component lineage on specific entities (e.g. discourse::discourse-session-auth-service). Make the intra-component flow detector emit self-loops for Ruby repos that match gold entity/evidence alignment. Do not change gold. Measure against pinned baseline; data-flows recall up from 10/158, precision not cratered, other layers unchanged.
payload.title: Detect intra-component flows for Ruby repos (discourse/redmine/spree)
